## Description

Rank stocks by returns over roughly the prior 12 months while skipping the most recent month.

## Where it may fit

Medium-term persistence where short-term reversals contaminate raw trailing momentum.

## Vehicles

Equity long-only, long-short, smart-beta ETFs and factor portfolios.

## Required data

Point-in-time adjusted monthly prices/returns; historical universe; corporate actions; transaction costs.

## Caveats

Factor premium can experience abrupt reversals and long drawdowns.
